title: Real content: seeding and editorial quality
description: Real items reach the board by manual research first, then through standard Papyrus monitoring. Order: decision models (SEO on 'decision models'), open TTS from the last year, later open LLMs. Every item has a primary source, a release date, evidence check states and score rationales. Nothing is marked Verified unless checked.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Board reconciliation 2026-10-22 (live checks 10:30-10:45Z). All seven children closed. Live: 70 real items in https://shipped.anth.us/llms.txt (40 open weights, 30 decisions in the wild), topic pages /topics/decision-models/ and /topics/open-tts/ 200, each item with a verdict, scores and evidence rows. Ongoing monitoring and further seeding is normal Papyrus operation, not part of this epic.
